name: Don Muang Tollway Public Company Limited
summary: Don Muang Tollway Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides elevated toll road services in Thailand. The company constructs and operates an elevated toll road; and offers toll collection, traffic management, rescue, and maintenance, as well as assistance services. It also provides design, construction, repairment, improvement, and reinforcement of infrastructure facilities services; and offers digital payment systems, traffic and safety management systems, and asset management solutions. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
